lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 8 ke kaaphee₂ mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiaa maran dhuraahu haumai roeeai ||
lines.translation: Death is ordained from the very beginning, and yet ego makes us cry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaai asathir hoeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, as Gurmukh, one becomes stable and steady. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore saabaas chalan jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed is the Perfect Guru, through whom the way of Death is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam s saar sabad samaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The sublime people earn the profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhe deh s aae maaiaa ||
lines.translation: The days of one's life are pre-ordained; they will come to their end, O mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲੑਿ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chalan aj k kalhi dhurahu phuramaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: birathaa janam tinaa jinhee naam visaariaa ||
lines.translation: Useless are the lives of those, who have forgotten the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jooai khelan jag k ihu man haariaa ||3||
lines.translation: They play the game of chance in this world, and lose their mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan maran sukh hoi jinhaa gur paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache sach sach samaaiaa ||4||12||64||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the true ones are truly absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||12||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath paai naam dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee bujh sach samaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh dhur likhiaa lekh tinhee naam kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny practice the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar sachai sachiaar mahal bulaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Lord summons the truthful to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar naam nidhaan guramukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Deep within is the treasure of the Naam; it is obtained by the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam dhiaai har gun gaaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar vasat anek manamukh nahee paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Deep within are infinite substances, but the self-willed manmukh does not find them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai garabai garab aap khuaaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: In egotism and pride, the mortal's proud self consumes him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aape aap aap khuaaeeai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, his identity consumes his identical identity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramat man paragaas sachaa paaeeai ||4||13||65||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind is illumined, and meets the True Lord. ||4||13||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaavaree ghar 16 ke 2 mahalaa 4 sudha(n)g ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaavaree, 2 Of Sixteenth House, Fourth Mehl, Sudhang:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau anadin har naam keeratan karau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mo kau har naam bataaiaa hau har bin khin pal rahi na sakau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has revealed to me the Name of the Lord; without the Lord, I cannot live, for a moment, even an instant. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai sravan simaran har keeratan hau har bin rahi na sakau hau ik khin ||
lines.translation: My ears hear the Lord's Kirtan, and I contemplate Him; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaise ha(n)s saravar bin rahi na sakai taise har jan kiu rahai har sevaa bin ||1||
lines.translation: As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's slave live without serving Him? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: kinahoo(n) preet laaee doojaa bhaau rid dhaar kinahoo(n) preet laaee moh apamaan ||
lines.translation: Some enshrine love for duality in their hearts, and some pledge love for worldly attachments and ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: har jan preet laaee har nirabaan pad naanak simarat har har bhagavaan ||2||14||66||
lines.translation: The Lord's servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of Nirvaanaa; Nanak contemplates the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||14||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaavaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee moro preetam raam bataavahu ree maaee ||
lines.translation: O mother, my mother, tell me about my Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har bin khin pal rahi na sakau jaise karahal bel reejhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment, even an instant; I love Him, like the camel loves the vine. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa man bairaag birakat bhaio har darasan meet kai taaee ||
lines.translation: My mind has become sad and distant, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaise al kamalaa bin rahi na sakai taise mohi har bin rahan na jaaee ||1||
lines.translation: As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, I cannot live without the Lord. ||1||
